description:
FILED s514a (Opus, 2026-10-10), found while writing Pl/t/storable-shim-01.t's structure dumper.

Reproducer (scratch/s514a/pr/refref5.pl), perl 5.40.3 vs PCL main 4d2fc9f0:

    my $r = \\[1];
    sub d3 { my ($v) = @_; return "'$v'" if !ref $v; return 'A' if ref $v eq 'ARRAY'; return '\\' . d3($$v) }
    print d3($r), "\n";      # perl \\A     PCL \\'1'
    sub d4 { my ($v) = @_; return "'$v'" if !ref $v; return 'A' if ref $v eq 'ARRAY'; my $w = $$v; return '\\' . d4($w) }
    print d4($r), "\n";      # both \\A

Emission of the call: `(pl-d3 (p-cast-$ $v))` inside `(p-tail-value (p-. "\\" (p-scalar-ctx ...)))` with `p-raw-params (($v :scalar))`.  Not reproduced when the self-call is not the tail expression (`return 'x' . m3($$v) if ...` is right, refref3.pl), nor with a different callee (`'\\' . g($$v)` is right, refref4.pl).  So the suspects are the direct self-call's argument passing of a `p-cast-$` PLACE into raw params (an alias of the box rather than its value?) in the tail position.  Cheap discriminating measurement: PCL_OPT=none on refref5.pl -- if right, the registry pass that licenses the raw/tail form is the cause.

MEASURED (s514a): under PCL_OPT=none all four subs answer as perl -- the cause is one of the named optimization passes (Pl/Passes.pm); bisect with PCL_OPT=-<name>.

MEASURED s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 10:50, main cc3caca6 = code 4d2fc9f0, probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p514a/refref5.pl through probe.sh): the ONE-level case `d3(\\[1])` prints \\A on main (perl \\A) -- the filed line "PCL \\'1'" did not reproduce here; the bug needs TWO reference levels: `d3(\\\\[2])` prints \\\\'2' where perl prints \\\\A.  Bisect over the registry: PCL_OPT=none -> perl's answer; PCL_OPT=-raw-slot -> perl's answer; -raw-numeric / -str-buffer / -foreach-range / -insensitive-call / -elem-setf -> still wrong.  CAUSE = the `raw-slot` Kind-A emission (the `p-raw-params (($v :scalar))` slot receives the `p-cast-$` PLACE's box, so the recursive frame reads the OUTER $v's referent one level too deep).  Fix shape: a self-call argument that is a deref PLACE must pass the VALUE (a copy) into a raw slot, as `my $w = $$v` does.  Guard: both depths + the non-tail spelling.

=== DONE (s514b) === commit 590f1a42.  NOT an emission fix: the cause is the BINDING.  A p-raw-params slot holds a raw value or a CONTAINER box, and the deref operators unbox a box found there once (p-cast-$).  %p-param-copy bound a REFERENCE VALUE (an is-ref wrapper made by p-backslash) bare, so when its referent is itself a box -- \\$x, \\[1], or $$v of a ref-to-ref whose anonymous referent is a wrapper -- $$v read one level too deep.  Measured: even a NON-recursive `sub t { my ($v)=@_; ref $$v } t(\\$x)` answered '' (perl SCALAR), which the brief's emission-side shape would have missed.  Fix: such an argument binds make-p-box around it (what the general @_ path's box-set stores).  Runtime-only, no generation.  COST (flagged): one box per call for a direct \$x / \\... argument; a container argument ($self, $r) and aggregate refs take no new branch.  Guard: NEW Pl/t/raw-slot-arg-01.t, 3 perl-oracle programs x {default, PCL_OPT=-raw-slot} (both depths, tail/non-tail, element arg, other callee, aliasing writes, refaddr identity, blessed scalar refs, reftype, glob ref); rows 1/3/5 fail on 134ca17f, 2/4/6 pass there.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a sub that recurses on `$$v` (`return "\\" . d3($$v)`) gets the WRONG argument when $$v holds an array ref -- `d3(\\[1])` reads the array ELEMENT 1 at the third level (perl \\A, PCL \\'1'); a temporary `my $w = $$v; d3($w)` is right
